import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def probe(name, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    frozen=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert got==expected,(name,got,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==frozen,(name,'input mutation')
    return {'id':name,'actual':got}

cases=[]
cases.append(probe('missing_names_sorted',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['z','a']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']}))
cases.append(probe('ineligible_superseder_ignored',{'claim':'x','conditions':{'k':1}},[{'source':'old','claim':'x','conditions':{'k':1},'value':'kept','verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'x','conditions':{'k':1},'value':'drop','verified':False,'supersedes':['old']}],{'required_conditions':['k'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'supported','value':'kept','sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]}))
cases.append(probe('eligible_cycle_removes_all',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'a','claim':'x','conditions':{},'value':1,'supersedes':['b']},{'source':'b','claim':'x','conditions':{},'value':1,'supersedes':['a']}],{'required_conditions':[]},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}))
cases.append(probe('nested_canonical_conflict',{'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[{'source':'a','claim':'x','conditions':{},'value':{'x':[1,2]}},{'source':'b','claim':'x','conditions':{},'value':{'x':[2,1]}}],{'required_conditions':[]},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}))
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
actual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
assert actual==report
print(json.dumps({'boundary_cases':cases,'report_matches':True},sort_keys=True))
